faqs.q: Is wonky fruit safe to eat?
faqs.a: Yes. 'Wonky' means the fruit looks different (a funny shape, a scar on the skin, a bit too big or small). It doesn't mean it's spoiled. Fruit with mould, odd smells or real deterioration never makes it into a Wonkypop.

faqs.q: Can I order Wonkypops for home delivery?
faqs.a: Not at the moment. Frozen treats don't travel well by post, so we don't ship to individual homes. Find us at a stockist, or send a bulk or event enquiry for parties, fetes and club days.
Keep them frozen at -18°C or colder and don't refreeze once thawed. Shelf life: [PLACEHOLDER]. Check the best-before date on the pack.

Our recipes are just fruit, water and a squeeze of citrus, so none of our current flavours contain milk, egg, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, sesame, gluten, fish, shellfish or lupin as ingredients. Full allergen information is printed on every pack and listed on our Flavours page. If you have a severe allergy, always check the pack before eating.

faqs.q: How does school or club fundraising work?
faqs.a: You order fundraising packs, sell them at your school or club and keep a share of the profit. We supply posters and promo material, and a dedicated account manager helps you along the way. See our Partnerships page for details.
